deadpan.instruct: Deadpan, completely flat matter-of-fact delivery, zero drama, totally calm.

dry_sarcasm.instruct: Understated dry sarcasm, flat conversational cynicism, subtle sarcastic deadpan, not theatrical.

tired_annoyance.instruct: Tired, disappointed annoyance, short exasperated sighing tone, fed up with teammate.

whisper_disbelief.instruct: Soft breathy whisper of utter existential disbelief, stunned confusion.

chuckle.instruct: Quiet sarcastic chuckle or snort before speaking, cynical amused disbelief.

casual.instruct: Casual, almost throwaway delivery, relaxed conversational speech among friends.

explosive_shout.instruct: Genuine loss of composure, sudden desperate shout, cracking with exasperation.
